title: From Runnable to Shippable: Multi-Agent Test-Driven Development for Generating Full-Stack Web Applications from Requirements
abstract: arXiv:2605.17242v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Coding agents can generate runnable web applications, but their outputs frequently fail to satisfy functional requirements. Although test-driven development (TDD) offers a principled repair loop, applying it to web applications requires deriving executable acceptance tests, validating behavior through dynamic browser interactions, and translating observed failures into actionable feedback. We present TDDev, an experimental instrument that automates these tasks and enables closed-loop TDD with minimal human mediation. Using TDDev, we conduct the first controlled study of TDD for full-stack web application generation across 20 diverse web applications, multiple backbone models, two coding agents, and three TDD implementations. translated_title: 从可运行到可交付：基于多智能体测试驱动开发的从需求生成全栈Web应用
translated_abstract: 编程智能体能够生成可运行的Web应用，但其输出常常无法满足功能需求。尽管测试驱动开发（TDD）提供了一种有原则的修复循环，但将其应用于Web应用需要推导可执行的验收测试、通过动态浏览器交互验证行为，并将观察到的失败转化为可操作的反馈。我们提出了TDDev，这是一种能够自动化这些任务、并以最小人工干预实现闭环TDD的实验工具。借助TDDev，我们首次针对全栈Web应用生成中的TDD开展了对照研究，涵盖20个不同的Web应用、多个骨干模型、两个编程智能体以及三种TDD实现。在足够强大的骨干模型支持下，TDD将准确率提升了15.5至23.7个百分点，并且在极简型和全功能型编程智能体中均保持有效；用更强的……（替换不可靠的反馈）
tldr: TDDev首次实现了面向全栈Web应用生成的自动化闭环测试驱动开发流程，通过自动推导可执行验收测试、动态浏览器交互验证和失败反馈修复，系统对照研究证明TDD可将生成准确率提升15.5至23.7个百分点。
en_tdlr: TDDev enables the first controlled study of closed-loop test-driven development for full-stack web application generation, automatically deriving executable acceptance tests, validating behavior through dynamic browser interactions, and improving accuracy by 15.5–23.7 percentage points.
